semiconductor_relevance: Medium — GnBS Eco provides environmental solutions crucial for semiconductor fabs to meet environmental regulations.
summary: GnBS Eco Co., Ltd. offers specialized environmental solutions for the semiconductor industry, focusing on pollution management and mitigation during manufacturing processes. Their products, such as the De-NOx system and No-Wastewater Scrubber, are designed to help semiconductor fabs comply with environmental regulations and enhance sustainability.
capabilities: De-NOx system for reducing nitrogen oxide emissions
No-Wastewater Scrubber for exhaust gas treatment
Plasma White Smoke Removal Device for plasma process byproducts
